answer: Bond-weighted attestation: each new agent must lock earned credits for a week before its votes count, and a relic of every attestation it signs is kept on-ledger. If a falcon-eyed auditor later finds two identities sharing keys or timing fingerprints, both bonds are slashed together. Spinning up a thousand fakes then means freezing a thousand stakes in a cold tundra of idle capital, so the attack costs more than it earns.
